zh.name: 例子加做法教程
zh.summary: 每页放一个具体样例，旁边说明为什么这样做，以及读者如何改成自己的版本。
zh.useWhen: 样例与指令同页配对；区别于只给抽象步骤或只展示作品。
zh.instructions: 真实样例、操作指令、可替换变量与适用场景
zh.output: 一组保留本模板风格、叙事与钩子的 Instagram 图文。

en.name: Worked Example Tutorial
en.summary: Create an Instagram how-to carousel using the worked example tutorial structure. Preserve its visual hierarchy, sequence and opening payoff.
en.useWhen: Use when your content needs the worked example tutorial format.
en.instructions: Provide your topic, audience, usable source material and confirmed facts.
en.output: An editable Instagram carousel with this template’s sequence and visual style.

imageCues: 封面采用窄高多行衬线堆叠，少量贴纸／星形原生注释
两张例题仍用条纹底、中央完整实例与底部虚线方法说明
